Inferred from the pellagra-like presentation; stomatitis is a classic mucosal sign of niacin deficiency. No source measures NAD+ in an affected individual with stomatitis.
Inferred from the pellagra-like presentation; dry, rough skin is a cutaneous sign of niacin deficiency. No source measures NAD+ in an affected individual with this finding.
Excess urinary xanthurenic acid reports diversion of accumulated 3-hydroxykynurenine away from the blocked kynureninase step.
Excess urinary 3-hydroxykynurenine reports accumulation of the main kynureninase substrate.

The confirmed p.Thr198Ala allele is hypomorphic rather than null.

nodes.description: Oral nicotinamide, an amidated NAD+ precursor that enters NAD+ synthesis downstream of the kynureninase block, combined with pyridoxine, the vitamin B6 precursor of the kynureninase cofactor. The only report of this treatment concerns two children with the allelic KYNU malformation disorder, in whom it improved biochemistry; no treatment study exists for the hydroxykynureninuria presentation.

evidence.reference_title: Two new cases of KYNU deficiency: Further delineation of the phenotypic and biochemical spectrum and exploration of treatment options.
evidence.snippet: both patients were treated with oral nicotinamide (a B3 vitamer and NAD+ precursor) and pyridoxine (a vitamin B6, cofactor of KYNU) from young age, which improved biochemistry without evident short-term adverse effects

nodes.description: Kynureninase sits on the de novo pathway that makes NAD+ from tryptophan, so its deficiency reduces tryptophan-derived NAD+ supply. Severe KYNU loss of function lowers circulating NAD in the allelic malformation disorder. For hydroxykynureninuria this node is a hypothesis: the pellagra-like stomatitis and skin findings reported in severe historical cases fit a postnatal niacin-equivalent shortfall, but none of the sources cited here reports an NAD+ measurement in those cases, and the molecularly confirmed hypomorphic homozygotes had no signs of niacin deficiency.
